pages.text: After the plaza fight, bring Greene's tissue back to Futian. Hold it and use it to follow the spore trail. Holding the tissue marks the den and its distance in the world. The marker is hidden in superflat saves. Once you are above the den, descend to the chamber.

After earning the pump milestone, enter the chamber on a non-Peaceful difficulty. You can continue if another player has the tissue or it was lost. Defeat the spider, then bring the goddess down and extract both arms and her head. Completing the head extraction grants Gaze Vacuole to participants.$(br2)$(l:recovery)Recover a lost lead$(/l)
